title: Advanced feature enhancements: animated UI, testimonials, live booking counter, service quiz, and parallax hero

requirements.text: Add an animated particle/star-field canvas layer behind the hero section in HeroSection.tsx that renders floating golden orbs, twinkling stars, and slow-drifting mandala outlines. The animation must be CSS/canvas-based, run continuously, and not affect page performance or accessibility.

quotes: Make it more advance beyond the imagination

acceptanceCriteria: Hero section displays animated golden particles and star-field in the background
Mandala outline shapes drift slowly across the hero area
Animation runs smoothly without janking or causing layout shift
Existing hero text, CTAs, and branding remain fully readable above the animation

requirements.text: Add an interactive 'Spiritual Profile Quiz' section to HomePage.tsx. The quiz presents 3–5 short multiple-choice questions (e.g., 'Which area of your life needs the most guidance?', 'What is your birth month range?') and, based on the answers, recommends one of the four services (Tarot, Numerology, Vastu, or Pronology) with a personalised recommendation card that includes a 'Book This Service' CTA linking to the booking form with the recommended service pre-selected.
acceptanceCriteria: Quiz section is visible on the homepage with at least 3 questions
Each question has clickable answer options styled with the cosmic/gold theme
After completing all questions, a recommendation card is shown with the matched service name, description, and a 'Book This Service' button
Clicking 'Book This Service' scrolls to the booking form and pre-selects the recommended service
Quiz can be retaken by clicking a 'Try Again' button

requirements.text: Add a live 'Bookings Counter' badge to the hero section in HeroSection.tsx that displays the total number of bookings submitted so far (fetched from the backend via a new public query `getTotalBookingCount(): async Nat` in backend/main.mo). Display it as a glowing gold stat, e.g., '✨ 42 Happy Clients Served'. Refresh every 60 seconds using React Query's refetchInterval.

quotes: Make it more advance beyond the imagination

acceptanceCriteria: backend/main.mo exposes a public query `getTotalBookingCount` returning the total number of bookings as Nat
HeroSection.tsx fetches and displays the total booking count with a gold-styled stat badge
The count auto-refreshes every 60 seconds
If the count is 0, display 'Be the first to book!' instead

requirements.text: Add a 'Client Testimonials' carousel section to HomePage.tsx between the Services section and the About section. Include at least 5 hardcoded testimonials with a client name, city, service used, star rating (5 stars), and quote. The carousel must auto-advance every 5 seconds and support manual prev/next navigation. Style it with the cosmic/gold theme, using a card layout with a subtle glow border.

quotes: Make it more advance beyond the imagination

acceptanceCriteria: Testimonials section is visible on the homepage with at least 5 testimonial cards
Each card shows client name, city, service used, 5-star rating, and a quote
Carousel auto-advances every 5 seconds
Manual prev/next arrow buttons allow user navigation
Active card is visually highlighted; inactive cards are dimmed
Section is styled consistently with the cosmic/gold theme

requirements.text: Add a parallax scroll effect to the hero section background image in HeroSection.tsx so that as the user scrolls down, the background image moves at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a depth effect. Implement using CSS `background-attachment: fixed` or a JS-based parallax listener. Ensure it degrades gracefully on mobile (disable parallax on small screens to avoid performance issues).

quotes: Make it more advance beyond the imagination

acceptanceCriteria: Hero background image exhibits a parallax scroll effect on desktop
Foreground content (heading, CTAs) scrolls at normal speed
Parallax is disabled on viewport widths below 768px
No layout shift or flicker when scrolling

requirements.text: Add an animated 'Services Highlight' ticker/marquee banner between the header and the hero section in HomePage.tsx. The ticker should continuously scroll text such as '✨ Tarot Card Reading · 🔢 Numerology · 🏠 Vastu Shastra · 🔤 Pronology · 📍 Bhubaneswar, Odisha · ₹400 per session · Book Now'. Style it with a gold gradient background and dark text, using a CSS marquee/keyframe animation.

quotes: Make it more advance beyond the imagination

acceptanceCriteria: A continuously scrolling marquee ticker is visible between the header and hero section
Ticker text includes all four services, location, and price
Animation is smooth and loops seamlessly
Styled with gold gradient background consistent with the cosmic theme

requirements.text: Add an 'Admin Analytics' summary panel to AdminPage.tsx that displays: (1) total booking count, (2) count of bookings by service type as a simple bar chart using CSS bar elements (no external chart library), (3) count of bookings by status (pending vs confirmed), and (4) most recent booking date. This panel should appear above the bookings table and be visible only when the admin is logged in.

quotes: Make it more advance beyond the imagination

acceptanceCriteria: Analytics panel appears above the bookings table on the admin dashboard
Shows total booking count, per-service breakdown, status counts, and most recent booking date
Per-service breakdown is rendered as a CSS-based bar chart
Panel is only visible when the admin principal is authenticated
Data is derived from the already-fetched bookings list (no additional backend calls required)

requirements.text: Add a 'Book via WhatsApp' quick-action floating button to the homepage that, when clicked, opens a pre-filled WhatsApp message to +918689838590 with the text 'Hi, I would like to book a consultation with Omm Vedic Numerloggy. Please let me know the available slots.' This button should be distinct from the existing floating chat button — position it at the bottom-left corner, styled with a gold/cosmic gradient, and labelled 'Book via WhatsApp'.

quotes: Make it more advance beyond the imagination

acceptanceCriteria: A floating 'Book via WhatsApp' button is fixed to the bottom-left of the screen
Button opens a WhatsApp deep link with the pre-filled booking inquiry message
Button is styled with a gold/cosmic gradient, distinct from the existing green floating WhatsApp button on the bottom-right
Button includes a WhatsApp icon and 'Book via WhatsApp' label
Link opens in a new tab

requirements.text: Add a 'Daily Cosmic Insight' section to the homepage in HomePage.tsx that displays a rotating daily spiritual/numerology tip. Implement a hardcoded array of at least 14 tips (one per day of a two-week cycle, selected by `dayOfYear % 14`). Display the tip inside a decorative card with a mandala border, a gold title 'Today's Cosmic Insight ✨', and the tip text. This section should appear between the Testimonials and the WhyChooseUs section.
acceptanceCriteria: A 'Today's Cosmic Insight' card is visible on the homepage
The displayed tip rotates based on the current day of the year (dayOfYear % 14)
At least 14 unique tips are hardcoded covering numerology, tarot, vastu, and pronology themes
Card is styled with a mandala/celestial border and gold typography consistent with the cosmic theme
Section is placed between the Testimonials carousel and the WhyChooseUs section

requirements.text: Enhance the booking form in BookingForm.tsx with a multi-step wizard UI. Split the form into 3 steps: Step 1 — Service & Category selection (service type + booking category); Step 2 — Personal Details (name, phone); Step 3 — Schedule & Message (preferred date, preferred time, optional message, price confirmation). Show a step progress indicator at the top with step numbers and labels. Include 'Next' and 'Back' buttons for navigation. Only submit to the backend on the final step.

quotes: Make it more advance beyond the imagination

acceptanceCriteria: Booking form is split into exactly 3 steps with a visible step progress indicator
Step 1 shows service type and booking category fields
Step 2 shows name and phone fields
Step 3 shows preferred date, preferred time, optional message, and the ₹400 price confirmation
'Next' button validates the current step's fields before advancing
'Back' button returns to the previous step without losing entered data
Backend submission only occurs on final step confirmation
Styled consistently with the existing cosmic/gold theme

constraints: Do not modify files listed in frontend.immutablePaths
All backend logic must remain in the single-actor backend/main.mo file
Do not use any external chart libraries — use CSS-only bar charts for analytics
Do not use any external carousel/slider libraries — implement with React state and CSS
WhatsApp number must remain 918689838590 with no spaces in all deep links
Maintain the existing cosmic/gold visual theme across all new sections
nonGoals: Video generation from images is not supported on this platform
Real-time WebSocket or push notification features
Integration with any external AI or LLM service
Google Maps embed or geolocation features
Payment gateway integration beyond the existing ₹400 price display
Email sending from the backend (mailto links only)

required: Decorative circular mandala border/frame illustration for the Daily Cosmic Insight card, deep navy background with intricate gold mandala ring pattern (mandala-insight-border.dim_600x600.png)
Horizontal celestial/cosmic banner strip with stars, constellations, and gold dust particles on dark navy background for the marquee ticker (marquee-ticker-bg.dim_1920x80.png)
Testimonial section background texture with subtle sacred geometry hexagon grid pattern in dark navy and muted gold (testimonials-bg.dim_1920x600.png)
